annotations.text:
A3 POSTER — 297 x 420 mm

Drawn at 1123 x 1587 px, which is 96 px per inch, so Export PDF prints it as one A3 page at true size. It scales down to A4 without reflowing.

Type, palette and the contour motif come from the live site. Body copy sits at 17-19px (12pt+) and the headline is 128px so it carries across a corridor.

The QR is live — it encodes the Google Form, forms.gle/f1AeBRNezv9K6Mjq9. Scan it before printing.

ONE PLACEHOLDER: [WEBSITE URL]. The Vercel address was not known when this was drawn. Replace it with the deployed URL, or say the word and I will.
